nodes.label: App Routing capability (app-routing)
nodes.rationale: Canonical spec updated by nav-reorg (shell moved to root, Gastos renamed CxP): Vite asset base, React Router 7 basename, auth guard, static app registry, mountable app subtrees.

nodes.label: Authentication Guard (RequireAuth)
nodes.rationale: Guard redirects to a per-subtree login destination while preserving the return URL; checks authentication ONLY, never context selection; permission checks preserved under subtree mounting.

nodes.label: Static App Registry
nodes.rationale: Code-level registry module; shell SHALL NOT query backend permissions for the launcher; cxp and rh entries enabled; adding an entry is code-only.

nodes.label: App Subtree Mounting
nodes.rationale: Mount an app subtree under a root-relative prefix without modifying the shell layout or guard logic; CxP subtree at /cxp/ is the first concrete mounted app, RH at /rh/ the second.

nodes.label: Global Login Route
nodes.rationale: Authenticates credentials + password+domain only, no context selection, redirects to hub on success.

nodes.label: Per-App Login Route Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each app subtree exposes its own login at /{app}/login, independent of the global login; may collect app-specific context.

nodes.label: Root Deployment Path (Vite base + basename)
nodes.rationale: Assets resolve relative to / and routing treats / as root; deep links reload without 404. Foundation-era version was the /CxP/ IIS virtual application prefix.
